messages:
jana: opened a PR to update the model catalog + card for aurora-lite3b variants, focusing on long-context/streaming quirks and quantized fallback notes. https://git.company/redwood/docs/pull/5121 :wave:
miguel: link thanks. what's the primary user concern here?
jana: customers hit unexpected truncation when streaming into `aurora-lite3b-int8` fallback. we needed to explain kernel limitations and recommended route configs (batching vs streaming).
sophie: can you show the short recommended route JSON and a CLI streaming example so support can repro?
jana: added a minimal route example and CLI: ```json
{
  "model": "aurora-lite3b+adapter:meridian-v1",
  "fallback_policy": ["aurora-lite3b-int8", "aurora-lite3b"],
  "streaming_mode": "chunked",
  "max_total_tokens": 2048
}
```
CLI: `rwctl infer --stream --model aurora-lite3b+adapter:meridian-v1 --input-file notes.txt --max-tokens 512 --prefer-quant-fallback`
lin: add a brief explanation that int8 kernels currently disable a merged KV layout so effective context may be lower when runtime chooses that path. also advise `max_total_tokens` conservative defaults.
jana: done. added a compatibility note: Private runtimes < v1.8 treat adapter variants as incompatible and will immediately choose base variant, which changes latency profile.
miguel: did you include perf numbers to justify recommending int8 first for latency-critical streaming?
jana: short appendix with g4dn numbers: aurora-lite3b p95 single-chunk = 140ms, aurora-lite3b-int8 p95 = 120ms, aurora-lite3b+adapter merged path p95 = 170ms. note: streaming multi-chunk overhead increases ~15% on adapter merges.
sophie: editorial: soften "will" -> "may" for fallback outcomes. and use "aims to preserve intent" for quality statements.
jana: updated wording. added three eval prompts in examples/aurora-stream-evals.md for QE: long-summarize, multi-turn chat, and headline rewrite.
docs-ci-bot: PR 5121 docs build: success ✅ - preview URL: https://docs-preview.company/5121
miguel: can QE run the streaming smoke so we can merge? I'll flag support to watch for tickets during next deploy.
jana: pinging QA now. will merge after green. :shipit:
